title: 13.4.0: Exercises
originalText:
For the following exercises, select the most representative decibel level for each sound.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{1}\)

Gas lawn mower: 70 dB, 100 dB, 120 dB

Exercise \(\PageIndex{2}\)

Radio playing loud enough to sing along to at home: 20 dB, 50 dB, 70 dB

Exercise \(\PageIndex{3}\)

Office noise on a floor of people working at desks: 40 dB, 60, dB, 80 dB

Exercise \(\PageIndex{4}\)

Conversation in a quiet room: 60 dB, 80 dB, 100 dB

Exercise \(\PageIndex{5}\)

Fast-moving train passing by when sitting in a car about 20 ft from the tracks with windows down: 40 dB, 60 dB, 80 dB

For the following exercises, state the requested note.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{6}\)

What is one half-step above G^(#)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{7}\)

What is one whole step down from G^(♭)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{8}\)

What is three half-steps above D?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{9}\)

What is two whole steps down from A^(#)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{10}\)

What is two half-steps down from E?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{11}\)

What is an octave above B_(4)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{12}\)

What is two octaves below F_(5)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{13}\)

What is three octaves above G_(2)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{14}\)

What is an octave below G_(2)?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{15}\)

Given that the frequency of \(A_4=440 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the frequency of \(A_1\) ?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{16}\)

Given that the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{F}_4=349 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{F}_5\), rounded to the nearest whole number?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{17}\)

Given that the approximate frequency of \(A_4{ }^{\#}=233 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the approximate frequency of \(A_6{ }^{\#}\), rounded to the nearest whole number?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{18}\)

Given that the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{D}_4=294 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{D}_2\), rounded to the nearest whole number?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{19}\)

Given that the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{G}_4{ }^{\#}=349 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the approximate frequency of \(\mathrm{G}_3{ }^{\#}\), rounded to the nearest whole number?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{20}\)

Given that the frequency of \(A_3=220 \mathrm{~Hz}\), what is the frequency of \(A_5\) ?
